description: This file declares an interface class IEventHandler within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, defining callback methods for various event types such as runtime, window, ripple, and state change events, all involving JSON data.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: Abstract interface for handling different event notifications as callback methods.

methods.name: onRuntimeManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles runtime manager events with associated JSON data.

methods.name: onWindowManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles window manager events with associated JSON data.

methods.name: onRippleEvent
methods.description: Handles ripple events identified by a name and additional JSON data.

methods.name: onStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles state change events with associated JSON data.
